shortDescription: Self-hosted homelab with Docker — NAS, media server, home automation, monitoring, and network-wide ad blocking
details:
Building out a home server from scratch with Docker for containerised services. The goal is a fully self-hosted stack covering all the things I don't want to rely on external services for.

Planned and in-progress services include: AdGuard Home for network-wide DNS filtering, Tailscale for remote access, Jellyfin or Plex for media, Jellystat for media analytics, a NAS setup with drive spin-down, Home Assistant integrated with Google Home, a Tadoo smart thermostat and smart radiator valves, and Vaultwarden as a self-hosted password manager. Monitoring and observability dashboards tie it all together.

The project is tracked as a GitHub project board — infrastructure-as-personal-project, built piece by piece.
